definitions.explanation: a cooking vessel used to cook food with steam

examples.japanese: {蒸|む}し{器|き}で{野菜|やさい}を{蒸|む}す。
examples.english: To steam vegetables in a steamer.

examples.japanese: {竹|たけ}の{蒸|む}し{器|き}を{買|か}った。
{蒸|む}し{器|き}で{茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}しを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made chawanmushi in a steamer.

examples.japanese: {電気|でんき}{蒸|む}し{器|き}は{温度|おんど}{管理|かんり}が{楽|らく}だ。
examples.english: Electric steamers make temperature control easy.

notes:
TYPES:
- {竹|たけ}の{蒸|む}し{器|き} - bamboo steamer (Chinese/Asian style)
- {金属|きんぞく}{製|せい} - metal steamer
- {電気|でんき}{蒸|む}し{器|き} - electric steamer
- せいろ - steaming basket (traditional Japanese/Chinese)

COMMON STEAMED DISHES:
- {茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}し - savory egg custard
- {蒸|む}し{野菜|やさい} - steamed vegetables
- {肉|にく}まん - steamed buns
- {点心|てんしん} - dim sum

RELATED EQUIPMENT:
- {圧力鍋|あつりょくなべ} - pressure cooker
- {鍋|なべ} - pot
